description: This file defines constants, enums, structs, and function prototypes for managing Zigbee device security, device information, and messaging within a Zigbee SDK. It includes device types, message commands, status structures, and parsing functions related to Zigbee device communication and security.

methods.name: parseDeviceInfoMessage
methods.description: Parses a device info message from raw bytes into a structured format.

methods.name: deviceInfoMessageToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a device info message.

methods.name: getFirmwareVersionFromDeviceInfoMessage
methods.description: Extracts a firmware version number from a device info message.

methods.name: convertLegacyFirmwareVersionToUint32
methods.description: Converts a legacy firmware version byte array to a uint32.

methods.name: legacyDeviceUpdateCommonResources
methods.description: Updates device resources with the latest status message info.
